new_candidates.date_enacted: 2026-07-06, Humboldt County Commission, unanimous vote on second reading of Bill No. 05-18-26 (one local news account describes the meeting as occurring July 7)
new_candidates.legal_basis: Bill No. 05-18-26 (Humboldt County), a temporary moratorium on the acceptance, processing, and approval of applications for new data center facilities in unincorporated Humboldt County; does not apply within the city of Winnemucca
new_candidates.trigger: Precautionary pause pending regulation; no data center proposal or development application was pending when the measure passed
new_candidates.current_status: Active as of 2026-07-31; set to expire 2027-07-13 absent further action
